title: The flying lesson
steps: You have untied the very last one when voices come from the field. Ilda is coming with the class, and nobody knows anything. {friend} quickly puts the black thread in a pocket.
Good morning, early birds! Each of you takes a broom from the shed. {wizard}, that one is yours for today: look after it well.
Look, the first-years carry their brooms like umbrellas! Last year, I crossed the lake on my very first day.

Zarek, to the end of the line. The broom lifts with a magic word, *drevo*, and flying crosses what walking cannot, like water and hedges. First exercise: walk to the end of the jetty, cast the word there, and fly without stopping to the white stone on the other bank.
{Me first, I want to fly right now!|I don't trust a stick that flies.}
Now it's your turn. The water shines ahead, and the white stone waits on the far side. Take a deep breath, hold your broom tight, and let's see what it can do.
